research_claim: Test whether a persistent LLM-free library of machine-selected verified typed tensor tools has causal and total-cost value on a post-freeze heterogeneous real-compiler workload stream.
chronology: freeze upstream source identities, adapters, shapes, candidate state, fixed baseline, gates, budgets, containment, and evaluator sources
independently recompute Foundry-0 prerequisites and required-arm readiness
stop before importing validation-v6 unless every prerequisite and required arm passes
commit a post-freeze seed only after authorization
select and execute held-out graphs and shapes using only the committed procedure
seal every arm output before evaluator-private outcomes are mounted
emit raw resource, compiler, numerical, provenance, tool-use, and removal ledgers
run evaluator verdict and stdlib-only independent recomputation

foundry_0_prerequisites.P1_external_control_conformance: four critical source-faithful or upstream controls must pass
foundry_0_prerequisites.P2_independent_corpus_and_invocation_tra: heldout source corpus and independently justified invocation horizon must be frozen
foundry_0_prerequisites.P3_complete_resource_meter: candidate and every required control arm must be process-tree metered
foundry_0_prerequisites.P4_independent_typed_tool_verifier: strict parser, interpreter, hostile tests, and replay must pass
foundry_0_prerequisites.P5_native_compiler_deduplication: every candidate must be classified and at least one nonduplicate or measured search distinction must survive
foundry_0_prerequisites.P6_unchanged_prospective_freeze: all code, state, gates, budgets, and sampling machinery must be hash-frozen before heldout selection

hard_validity_gates: V03 no candidate-visible provenance or gate leakage
V04 every arm sealed before outcomes
V05 complete eager and compiled type-shape-layout-alias-storage checks
V06 maximum absolute error at most 1e-5
V08 native dedup or disclosed measured search distinction
V10 A5-A9 conformance and budget equivalence
scientific_gates: R01 four tools survive verification and native dedup
R02 three surviving tools receive heldout reuse receipts
R03 two exact digests transfer across families
R05 causal tool-removal loss or cost increase
R06 primary endpoint beats strongest A3-A9 control
R07 candidate beats stock at independently justified N*
R10 at least one non-predeclared useful tool
stop_conditions: no candidate tool survives native-compiler deduplication
development gains disappear under total compute matching

execution_policy.on_failed_prerequisite: execute documented remediation without importing validation-v6
execution_policy.on_all_prerequisites_pass: freeze post-freeze seed and execute exactly once without outcome-driven intervention
